text:
Mira: Quick sync — we need to lock down MVP margin-conservation rules for the next milestone. TL;DR: SLOs are OK but token cost is spiking on long-context flows. Propose priority: 1) auth/SSO (customer-critical), 2) search/assist baseline, 3) non-critical UI helpers. Sharing proposed heatmap and cuts.
Alex: +1. paste the heatmap? also what's the model-pinning impact on cost if we keep production pinned to 7B quantized vs 13B fp16?
Mira: Heatmap snapshot:
```
feature | impact | avg tokens | cost delta | suggested action
Auth flow | high | 120 | +0.9x | keep - optimize prompts
Search rerank | medium | 60 | +0.5x | restrict to top-3
UI helpers | low | 30 | +0.2x | cut for MVP
Bulk export | medium | 400 | +1.2x | postpone to v1
``` 
Sam: Customer A will push back on rerank cut. Can we compromise: keep rerank for paid tenants only and degrade to cached results for free tier?
Jordan: Ops note: if we keep rerank, we'll need dedicated capacity for steady throughput. Canary plan: 48h on dedicated with traffic mirror, fallback policy to quantized-13B-lite model if latency > 350ms.
Evan: Proposal for acceptance criteria (MVP vs v1):
- MVP: auth flows <= 250ms p95, cost <= $X per 1k tokens (team to compute), functional rerank limited to top-3, no bulk exports.
- v1: add full rerank, bulk export, richer UI helpers, tighter SLOs.
Mira: Agree. Also adding regression guardrails: any eval that drops relevance score >2% must block release.
pm-bot: Document created: https://docs.redwood.ai/scope/margin-conservation (sheet: https://sheets.example.com/abc123)
Alex: Vote: :thumbsup: keep auth optimizations, :thinking: rerank compromise, :thumbsdown: UI helpers
Sam: :thumbsup: paid-tier rerank
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Evan: :thinking: want clearer cost target
Mira: Next steps: Mira to update the spreadsheet with the cuts and owners by EOD. Jordan to draft canary runbook. Sam to draft customer-facing note for Customer A about paid-tier tradeoff. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00am PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
